title: 1D Wave Equation - Leapfrog (FDM)
desc.equation: One-dimensional wave equation for the transverse displacement u(x, t) of a string, with propagation speed c:
desc.domain: String of length L, uniform grid of nₓ points; time from 0 to t_max:
desc.ic.intro: Initial displacement set by the selector, and zero initial velocity:
desc.method: Finite Difference Method with the explicit leapfrog scheme: second-order central differences in space and time. The time step is Δt = CFL·Δx/c, with CFL ≤ 1 for stability. The frames are rendered and combined into a GIF.
desc.reference.sine: Sine: standing wave obtained by separation of variables,
desc.reference.pulse: Pulse: d'Alembert's formula with the odd, 2L-periodic extension ũ₀ of the initial displacement, which enforces the fixed ends,
